name: Distracting Jarven
summary: At Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Jarven Thunderbrew watches the cellar stores. His family forbids him to drink from the barrels while on duty, so he asks you to bring him Thunder Ale from upstairs. He hopes a mug will sharpen his wits.

sections.title: A Thirsty Guard on Duty
sections.body: Jarven watches the deep stores, with Dun Morogh’s finest stout all around him. His family forbids him to drink from the stock while he is on guard. Yet temptation gets the better of him, and he asks you to fetch a pint of potent Thunder Ale from the taps upstairs.

sections.title: A Dubious Sharpener
sections.body: Jarven says a good drink will sharpen his senses and strengthen his watch. Whether a guard ought to drink on duty is another matter. Still, few hardy dwarves can fault a Thunderbrew for wanting a taste of the ale his own kin make.

faq.answer: Jarven Thunderbrew belongs to the renowned Thunderbrew family. He watches the stored casks in the cellar of Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.

faq.q: Why does Jarven need someone to bring him ale?
faq.answer: Jarven's family forbids him to drink from the cellar stock while he is on watch. So he asks an outsider to bring him a fresh mug from upstairs, leaving the sealed casks untouched.
The innkeeper and bartenders serve Thunder Ale upstairs in the main taproom of Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderbrew Distillery located?
faq.answer: Thunderbrew Distillery is the central inn in Kharanos, in the snowy heart of Dun Morogh. It lies just down the mountain from Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is Thunderbrew ale so famous?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew clan's stout and ales are famous across Khaz Modan and beyond. Their strong punch, flavor, and dwarven kick are known far and wide.

faq.q: Does getting Jarven drunk cause any trouble?
faq.answer: Jarven says the ale sharpens his wits instead of dulling them. But it keeps his attention from anyone poking around the lower storage.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the agony of standing guard beside casks of legendary ale without a single swallow.
As a rogue, you know strong liquor can distract a watchman. Jarven asks for that distraction himself.
